about: The genome's ladder. Every stage is defined as code and is DORMANT until you grow it; growing is reversible (hibernate) and your data survives sleep. Nature names are the metaphor, crawl/walk/run/fly the gait.

stages.what: The laptop foundation: guardrail gateway, model router, local+cloud models, chat, Guiding Map, sync, automation.

An always-on security core on one machine: Keycloak (SSO/MFA), OpenBao (secrets), SeaweedFS (S3), Prometheus+Alertmanager. Optional organs: Wazuh (SIEM/XDR), MISP (threat intel), TheHive (incident response).
stages.where: one always-on machine: a mini-PC/server, or the same laptop when you want it
stages.dormant_cost: none (volumes keep your data; containers stopped)

stages.what: One cloud VM running k3s (a real, tiny Kubernetes) with Argo CD pulling the platform from git. State lives on a persistent encrypted disk, so sleep/wake keeps everything.
stages.where: AWS (one EC2 instance, no inbound ports; SSM or tailscale access)
stages.dormant_cost: the vault (encrypted bucket + KMS key) and the persistent data disk: cents to a few dollars a month
stages.awake_cost: one VM + its disk (size small/medium/large); check the provider calculator for your region

stages.what: Managed Kubernetes (EKS Auto Mode / GKE Autopilot / AKS) that adds and removes nodes by itself, with Argo CD, policy-as-code (Kyverno), runtime detection (Falco), backups (Velero) and scale-to-zero (KEDA).
stages.dormant_cost: the vault only: the cluster and NAT are destroyed on sleep (a managed control plane bills by the hour even with zero nodes, which is why sleep removes it)
stages.awake_cost: control plane (about 0.10 USD per cluster-hour on EKS/GKE, per third-party reports: verify) + nodes while pods run + NAT

stages.what: A multi-tenant managed service: every tenant is a differentiated cell (own namespace, quota, zero-trust network policy, gateway, OIDC-group RBAC, metering, and (AWS) its own encryption key and object store) stamped from one template, with per-tenant usage and SLA dashboards.
stages.where: canopy + tenants (per-tenant cloud isolation implemented on AWS)
stages.dormant_cost: vault + each tenant's key and bucket (data persists through sleep)

sizes.small: t3.large-class node / 100 GB roots (tree); small Azure pools
